_comment: Build config as code, so it is reviewable and survives a service being recreated.
Read from the service's Root Directory (apps/api), which is a service-level setting and
therefore the one thing that cannot live here — it is what tells Railway where to find this file.
Why it exists: the GitHub connection deployed on push and every build FAILED, because the
service had no root directory and Railpack analysed the repo root, found a pnpm workspace with
no app it recognised, and exited. The old container kept serving, so production looked merely
